categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Refond Optoelectronics Co., Ltd. primarily operates in LED packaging and related solutions, focusing on LED lighting, automotive LED, touch display, Mini LED display, and electronic paper products. The company provides comprehensive LED light source solutions including packaging process design, optical design, driving design, heat dissipation design, LED device packaging, technical services, and standard light source module integration. It also develops automotive lighting and display systems, Mini LED backlight and direct display products, and electronic paper modules for various applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced LED packaging technologies including SMD LED, Mini LED, Micro LED, infrared LEDs, VCSEL, and special packaging light sources. It emphasizes innovation in packaging structure, optical design, driving design, and heat dissipation. The company has developed Mini LED COB blue/white light backlight series with AEC-Q102 automotive reliability certification and employs automated production lines. It also invests in R&D for Micro LED, electronic paper, laser applications, and automotive-grade LED technologies such as ADB matrix headlights and Smart RGB ambient lighting.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Refond serves a broad range of customers including domestic and international electronics manufacturers, automotive companies, and display device producers. Key markets include consumer electronics (TVs, laptops, VR devices), automotive lighting and display systems, industrial and commercial lighting, and electronic paper applications in education and advertising. The company has established long-term relationships with major clients such as Hyundai, Nissan, TCL, and other global brands.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant sales in the Pearl River Delta, Yangtze River Delta, other regions of mainland China, and overseas markets. It has subsidiaries and operations in Shenzhen, Ningbo, Changzhou, Hubei, Zhejiang, and Germany. Overseas sales are supported through direct sales and agency channels, covering major international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Refond operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the LED supply chain, focusing on LED packaging and module integration. It sources raw materials such as chips and substrates from upstream suppliers and provides finished LED products and modules to end customers in lighting, automotive, and display sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in Mini LED and Micro LED technologies, automotive LED lighting and display solutions, electronic paper, and laser applications. It invests heavily in R&D, maintaining a national-level LED research center and continuously upgrading production capabilities towards intelligent, automated manufacturing. Strategic initiatives include expanding Mini LED backlight and direct display applications, developing automotive-grade LED products with high reliability, and advancing electronic paper technology for education and commercial use.
categories.revenue_model: Refond generates revenue primarily through the sale of LED products and electronic paper modules. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales to end customers and supplemented by agency sales for overseas and smaller domestic markets. The company also earns income from investment returns and government subsidies related to its high-tech status.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in LED packaging and a pioneer in SMD LED packaging in China. Major competitors include Seoul Semiconductor (South Korea), Everlight Electronics (Taiwan), Nationstar Optoelectronics, Refond's peer companies like Shenzhen Jufei Optoelectronics, and Hongli Zhihui Group. Refond positions itself as a technology leader with strong R&D capabilities and a broad product portfolio, especially in Mini LED and automotive LED sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Refond reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.54 billion, a 12.17% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 31.58 million, a significant turnaround from a loss in 2023. The company’s LED products accounted for over 90% of revenue, with electronic paper products growing rapidly. It maintains total assets of about RMB 3.39 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 2.13 billion. The company has shown steady growth and improved profitability driven by product mix optimization and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Refond emphasizes innovation-driven product development, offering high-quality, high-value LED solutions with superior performance such as high brightness, energy efficiency, and automotive-grade reliability. Its Mini LED and Micro LED technologies provide enhanced display quality, lower power consumption, and longer lifespan compared to traditional displays. The company’s automotive LED products feature advanced features like ADB matrix lighting and Smart RGB ambient lighting, differentiating through integration, customization, and compliance with stringent automotive standards. Additionally, its electronic paper products cater to emerging markets with low power consumption and eye-friendly displays.
